items.body:
Full transparency about how we process your personal data

Last updated: 27 April 2026

items.title: 1. Data controller
items.body:
In compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD), the controller of your data is Valencia Mejor Esta Vida, with registered address at Calle Gran Vía 10, 46002 Valencia, Spain.

Privacy contact: privacidad@valenciaeslavida.com

items.title: 2. Data we collect
items.body:
Depending on how you use the site, we may collect:

We do not collect especially sensitive data or data of minors without parental consent.
bullets: Browsing data: IP address, browser, pages visited and length of visit.
Contact data: name, email and message when you fill in the form.
Chatbot queries: the questions put to the virtual assistant.
Cookies: files on your device to improve the browsing experience.

items.title: 3. Purpose of processing
bullets: Answering the queries sent through the form or the chatbot.
Improving the website through anonymous statistical analysis of browsing.
Sending you tourist information if you have given us your express consent.
Complying with the legal obligations that apply to us.

items.title: 4. Legal basis
bullets: Consent (art. 6.1.a GDPR): acceptance of non-essential cookies or subscription to communications.
Performance of a contract (art. 6.1.b GDPR): management of bookings or ticket purchases.
Legitimate interest (art. 6.1.f GDPR): anonymous statistical analysis to improve the service.
Legal obligation (art. 6.1.c GDPR): retention of data required by regulations.

items.title: 5. Data retention
bullets: Contact form: until the query is resolved and for a maximum of 2 years.
Analytics cookies: never more than 2 years.
Transaction data: 5 years in accordance with tax regulations.
Chatbot queries: active session plus 90 days for quality control.

items.title: 6. Recipients
items.body: We do not disclose your data to third parties except in the following cases:
bullets: Technology providers (hosting, analytics) under a confidentiality agreement and as data processors.
Public authorities when the law requires us to (court or tax requests).
Google LLC for Google Analytics, with the transfer covered by EU standard contractual clauses.

items.title: 7. Your rights
items.body:
You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection at any time by sending an email to privacidad@valenciaeslavida.com with a copy of your identity document.

If you believe we are infringing your rights, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) at www.aepd.es.

items.title: 8. Cookies
items.body: You can configure or reject non-essential cookies in the cookie banner or in your browser settings.
bullets: Technical (essential) cookies: necessary for browsing. They do not require consent.
Analytics cookies: Google Analytics for anonymous statistics. They require consent.
Preference cookies: remember the language and settings chosen.

items.title: 9. Minors
items.body: Our site is aimed at people over 14. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with data without your consent, contact us at privacidad@valenciaeslavida.com so that we can delete it immediately.

items.title: 10. Changes to this policy
items.body:
We may update this policy to reflect regulatory changes or improvements in our data management. We will publish the new version on this page with the update date visible. If the changes are significant, we will notify you by email.

Do you have questions about privacy? Write to us at privacidad@valenciaeslavida.com
